Why Ronova Mesh requests these permissions:
Bluetooth permissions are configured with neverForLocation. Your GPS location is never accessed, tracked, or shared.
Ronova Mesh has no tracking backend, telemetry, analytics, or advertising trackers. All direct communications occur peer-to-peer over local Bluetooth radios.
Each message is encrypted with ECDH secp256r1 key agreement and AES-256-GCM. Intermediate relay nodes forward ciphertexts blindly without decryption access.
Bluetooth permissions are declared with neverForLocation. Ronova Mesh never accesses, tracks, or records your GPS or cellular location coordinates.
Direct voice calls stream 16kHz PCM audio directly over Bluetooth RFCOMM without saving any voice recording.
